title: Police pursue car through Syracuse neighborhoods after robbery reported
summary: Syracuse Police Department responded to a robbery at Lower Onondaga Park on October 6, 2026, pursuing a vehicle operated by juveniles through nearby neighborhoods. Officers lost visual contact with the suspects during the pursuit. The incident highlights operational challenges in public safety response and suspect apprehension.
